purpose: Preserve exact independent inline pair-analysis source for later archival; not an executable UI or collector tool.
execution: Before content reads, require six known files to exist, then two-second stable metadata and age. Process index sequentially. Each pair report written exclusively; existing report returns without SAV re-read. Monitor polls known filenames only, captures wait states, stops after first failed pair. No progress receipt, UI, log, ordinary non-HP export or startup claim.

from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,hashlib,time,zipfile
from datetime import datetime,timezone
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
root=Path(r'D:\workspace\xenoamess_stellaries_dev\eat_everything_origin')
run=Path(r'C:\Users\1\AppData\Local\xenoamess_stellaries_dev\artifacts\1019-implementation\runs\20261019T164112Z')
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'tools'))
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'testing'))
snapshot_path=root/'tools/check_growth_1019.py'
import check_growth_1019 as c
TREE='61b34f6dbdc277c44364889d5f1e1cd2773a4624786bbf0d538079fc6ba4feb0'
import runtime_growth_1019 as g
index=int(sys.argv[1]);assert 0<=index<len(g.NODES)
matter=g.NODES[index]
out=root/'docs/evidence/1019-analysis'/f'rc7-growth-pair-n{index:02}-c{matter}-observation-v1.json'
if out.exists():
 print(json.dumps({'state':'ALREADY_OBSERVED_NO_REREAD','index':index,'report':str(out)}));raise SystemExit()
files=[run/(f'r7mx-n{index:02}-c{matter}-{phase}'+ext) for phase in ('refresh','final') for ext in ('.sav','.audit.json','.growth-observation.json')]
missing=[p.name for p in files if not p.exists()]
if missing:
 print(json.dumps({'state':'WAITING_FILES_NO_CONTENT_READ','index':index,'missing':missing}));raise SystemExit()
def meta(p):
 s=p.stat();return [s.st_size,s.st_mtime_ns]
before={str(p):meta(p) for p in files}
time.sleep(2)
if before!={str(p):meta(p) for p in files} or any(time.time_ns()-p.stat().st_mtime_ns<2_000_000_000 for p in files):
 print(json.dumps({'state':'WAITING_STABILITY_NO_CONTENT_READ','index':index}));raise SystemExit()
checker_sha=hashlib.sha256(snapshot_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert checker_sha=='a8d70f1015b6f1f4026ae811c38653997fd41a55bbca9b9b8fba391fb4070bf5'
model_paths=[root/f'docs/evidence/1019-analysis/six-core-source-expectations-v{k}.json' for k in range(1,6)]
assert [hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in model_paths]==list(c.MODEL_HASHES)
v5=json.loads(model_paths[-1].read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
manifest_raw=(run/'manifest.json').read_bytes();manifest=json.loads(manifest_raw)
assert manifest['copied_mod_tree_sha256']==manifest['repository_mod_tree_sha256']==TREE
assert manifest['run_id']=='20261019T164112Z' and manifest['language']=='l_simp_chinese'
mod=Path(manifest['copied_mod'])
actual=[{'path':p.relative_to(mod).as_posix(),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in sorted(mod.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]
assert sorted(actual,key=lambda x:x['path'])==sorted(v5['frozen_rc7']['files'],key=lambda x:x['path'])
anchor_path=run/'r7ganchor.native-save.json'
anchor_bytes=anchor_path.read_bytes();anchor=json.loads(anchor_bytes)
assert anchor['date']=='2201.01.01' and anchor['sha256']=='aec53eeed736d23abb856b7a1c1696657ce55517124097f1ad6c69921f1d8385'
date=anchor['date']
for _ in range(index*2):date=g.next_month(date)
dates=[g.next_month(date)];dates.append(g.next_month(dates[0]))
rows=[];states=[];sources=[]
def add(name,observed,expected):
 c.check(rows,name,observed,expected)
for offset,phase in enumerate(('refresh','final')):
 sav,audit_path,observation_path=files[offset*3:offset*3+3]
 # Final files are immutable after the collector's write_new completes.
 s=c.read_save(sav);audit_raw=audit_path.read_bytes();obs_raw=observation_path.read_bytes()
 audit,obs=json.loads(audit_raw),json.loads(obs_raw)
 add(phase+' native date',s['date'],dates[offset])
 add(phase+' Mother identity',[s['fleet'],s['ship'],s['owners']],[125,809,[0]])
 add(phase+' audit ZIP SHA',audit.get('save_sha256'),s['sha256'])
 add(phase+' audit gamestate SHA',audit.get('gamestate_sha256'),s['gamestate_sha256'])
 add(phase+' audit date',audit.get('date'),s['date'])
 add(phase+' observation ZIP SHA',obs.get('save_sha256'),s['sha256'])
 add(phase+' observation gamestate SHA',obs.get('gamestate_sha256'),s['gamestate_sha256'])
 add(phase+' observation date',obs.get('date'),s['date'])
 add(phase+' observation identity',[obs.get('fleet_id'),obs.get('ship_id')],[125,809])
 add(phase+' observation native health',obs.get('native_ship'),s['health'])
 add(phase+' Machine civic','civic_machine_terminator' in s['government'],True)
 for row in c.counts(s,matter):
  row['check']=phase+' / '+row['check'];rows.append(row)
 states.append(s)
 sources.extend([{'path':str(sav),'sha256':s['sha256'],'metadata':before[str(sav)]},
  {'path':str(audit_path),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(audit_raw).hexdigest(),'metadata':before[str(audit_path)]},
  {'path':str(observation_path),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(obs_raw).hexdigest(),'metadata':before[str(observation_path)]}])
refresh,final=states
if index==0:
 reference={'prediction_input':{'health':final['health'],'ship_variables':final['ship_variables']},
  'layout':final['layout'],'government':final['government'],'ordinary_ships':refresh['ordinary_ships'],
  'fleet':125,'ship':809,'path':final['path'],'sha256':final['sha256'],'date':final['date']}
 previous_tiers={key:0 for key in c.TIERS}
else:
 baseline_path=root/'docs/evidence/1019-analysis/rc7-growth-pair-n00-c0-observation-v1.json'
 baseline=json.loads(baseline_path.read_bytes());assert baseline['node']==0 and baseline['C']==0
 assert not baseline['failed_checks'], 'C0 independent baseline has unresolved failed checks'
 reference=baseline['reference_for_later_pairs']
 previous_path=root/'docs/evidence/1019-analysis'/f'rc7-growth-pair-n{index-1:02}-c{g.NODES[index-1]}-observation-v1.json'
 previous=json.loads(previous_path.read_bytes());previous_tiers=previous['actual_final']['fleet_tiers']
government_observations=[]
for phase,s in zip(('refresh','final'),states):
 add(phase+' stable layout',s['layout'],reference['layout'])
 government_observations.append(c.matrix_government_comparison(rows,phase+' stable government', {'date':reference['date'],'government':reference['government']},s))
 add(phase+' tiers never decrease',all(s['fleet_variables'].get(key,-1)>=previous_tiers.get(key,0) for key in c.TIERS),True)
add('refresh-final tiers/rewards unchanged',{key:refresh['fleet_variables'].get(key) for key in (*c.TIERS,'eep_component_rewards')},
 {key:final['fleet_variables'].get(key) for key in (*c.TIERS,'eep_component_rewards')})
predicted=c.prediction(reference['prediction_input'],final)
for key,value in predicted.items():
 if key.startswith('max_'):c.close_hp(rows,'final native '+key,final['health'].get(key),value)
 else:c.close(rows,'final export '+key,final['ship_variables'].get(key),value)
for probe,health in [('eep_probe_max_hull','max_hitpoints'),('eep_probe_max_armor','max_armor_hitpoints')]:
 c.close_hp(rows,'refresh-day trigger '+probe,final['ship_variables'].get(probe),refresh['health'][health])
controls=reference['ordinary_ships'];add('nonempty ordinary control',bool(controls),True)
coverage={key:any(type(values.get(key)) in (int,float) and values[key]>0 for values in controls.values()) for key in c.HEALTH if key.startswith('max_')}
for key,covered in coverage.items():add('positive ordinary native '+key,covered,True)
for phase,s in zip(('refresh','final'),states):
 add(phase+' ordinary identities',sorted(s['ordinary_ships']),sorted(controls))
 for identity in sorted(set(controls)&set(s['ordinary_ships'])):
  for key,expected in controls[identity].items():
   observed=s['ordinary_ships'][identity][key]
   if expected is None:add(phase+' ordinary absent '+identity+'/'+key,observed,None)
   else:c.close_hp(rows,phase+' ordinary max '+identity+'/'+key,observed,expected)
level=matter//10;rank={kind:final['fleet_variables'][key] for kind,key in zip(c.KINDS,c.TIERS)}
coeff={'max_hitpoints':(1500,3000,'hull'),'max_armor_hitpoints':(1287,2574,'armor'),'max_shield_hitpoints':(2091.375,4182.75,'shield')}
attribution=[]
for key,(per_level,per_rank,kind) in coeff.items():
 start=reference['prediction_input']['health'][key];observed=final['health'][key]
 attribution.append({'channel':key,'C0_intercept':start,'L':level,'tier_kind':kind,'tier':rank[kind],
  'base_growth_contribution':per_level*level,'component_contribution':per_rank*rank[kind],
  'expected':predicted[key],'observed':observed,'raw_delta':observed-predicted[key]})
for key in g.MODIFIERS:
 lpart=npart=0;kind=None
 if key in ('ship_hull_mult','ship_armor_mult','ship_shield_mult'):
  kind=key.split('_')[1];lpart=.05*level;npart=.1*rank[kind]
 elif key=='ship_weapon_damage':kind='damage';lpart=.05*level;npart=.05*rank[kind]
 elif key=='ship_tracking_add':kind='tracking';npart=3*rank[kind]
 elif key in ('ship_hull_regen_add_static','ship_armor_regen_add_static'):kind='regen';lpart=.1*level;npart=.2*rank[kind]
 probe='eep_probe_'+key;observed=final['ship_variables'][probe];start=reference['prediction_input']['ship_variables'][probe]
 attribution.append({'channel':key,'C0_intercept':start,'L':level,'tier_kind':kind,'tier':rank[kind] if kind else 0,
  'base_growth_contribution':lpart,'component_contribution':npart,'expected':predicted[probe],
  'observed':observed,'raw_delta':observed-predicted[probe]})
assert before=={str(p):meta(p) for p in files},'immutable inputs changed during pair analysis'
failed=[row for row in rows if not row['passed']]
report={'schema':'eep.rc7-growth-pair-observation.v1','status':'FAIL_OBSERVATION' if failed else 'OBSERVATION_ONLY',
 'scope':'Completed immutable refresh/final pair only; no full matrix/UI/log/progress-receipt acceptance',
 'observed_at_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'run_id':manifest['run_id'],
 'production_tree_sha256':TREE,'node':index,'C':matter,'source_models_sha256':list(c.MODEL_HASHES),
 'checker_sha256':checker_sha,'checker_source_path':str(snapshot_path),'source_verification':'copied full59 equals immutable v5; no runtime log or UI read',
 'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(manifest_raw).hexdigest(),'anchor_receipt':{'path':str(anchor_path),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(anchor_bytes).hexdigest(),'date':anchor['date']},
 'sources':sources,'checks':rows,'check_count':len(rows),'failure_count':len(failed),'failed_checks':failed,
 'hp_tolerance_contract':c.HP_TOLERANCE_CONTRACT,'modifier_abs_tol':c.TOLERANCE,'relative_tolerance':0,
 'actual_refresh':{'date':refresh['date'],'sha256':refresh['sha256'],'health':refresh['health'],'design_id':refresh['design_id'],'design_body_sha256':refresh['design_body_sha256'],'country_progression':{key:refresh['country_variables'].get(key) for key in ['eep_c','eep_mothership_level','eep_mothership_next','eep_component_entitled','eep_component_rewards','eep_component_pending','eep_component_snapshot_state']},'fleet_tiers':{key:refresh['fleet_variables'].get(key) for key in c.TIERS}},
 'actual_final':{'date':final['date'],'sha256':final['sha256'],'design_id':final['design_id'],'design_body_sha256':final['design_body_sha256'],
  'country_progression':{key:final['country_variables'].get(key) for key in ['eep_c','eep_mothership_level','eep_mothership_next','eep_component_entitled','eep_component_rewards','eep_component_pending','eep_component_snapshot_state']},
  'fleet_tiers':{key:final['fleet_variables'].get(key) for key in c.TIERS},'health':final['health'],
  'modifier_exports':{key:final['ship_variables'].get('eep_probe_'+key) for key in g.MODIFIERS},
  'trigger_exports':{key:final['ship_variables'].get(key) for key in ['eep_probe_max_hull','eep_probe_max_armor']},
  'fleet_modifiers':final['fleet_modifiers'],'ship_modifiers':final['ship_modifiers'],'ordinary_ships':final['ordinary_ships']},
 'government_time_observations':government_observations,'source_separated_attribution':attribution,'ordinary_controls':{'ship_ids':sorted(controls),'coverage':coverage,
  'scope':'Native maximum H/A/S only; no ordinary damage/tracking/regen export claim'},
 'reference_for_later_pairs':reference if index==0 else None,
 'limits':['Only fixed completed sample pairs through this node have been inspected; no future or in-progress sample read.','Imported C0 anchor, not an RC7 new-game year; no startup_stability claim.','No HUD, console action, runtime log or progress receipt has been read.','No native healing rate or panel DPS claim.','This is not a full growth/repeat/reload/budget PASS.']}
g.write_new(out,report)
print(json.dumps({'status':report['status'],'node':index,'C':matter,'date':final['date'],'checks':len(rows),'failed':len(failed),
 'actual_final':report['actual_final'],'report':str(out),'report_sha256':hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'failed_checks':[{**row,'actual':'raw government retained in immutable report','expected':'raw government retained in immutable report'} if 'government' in row['check'] else row for row in failed]},ensure_ascii=False))
